name: Fulbright-Nehru Postdoctoral Research Fellowship
funder: United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF) / Fulbright Program
amount: Monthly stipend, round-trip economy airfare, J-1 visa support, accident and sickness cover, settling-in and professional allowances; dependent allowance subject to funds
other_rules: PhD or DM awarded within the 4 years before the deadline
Government of India and state government employees not eligible (CSIR, ICAR, DRDO, ISRO, IISc, IIT researchers are eligible)
employed applicants need a home-institution letter granting leave
only one Fulbright-Nehru category per cycle
2027-28 cycle limited to priority fields (life sciences only via bioengineering)
notes: Stays of 8-24 months; the duration you request cannot be changed later. 2027-28 cycle opened 18 Feb 2026 and closed 15 Jul 2026. A host invitation letter is optional but recommended. Contact postdoc@usief.org.in.

documents.name: Letter of support from home institution
